name: Bibbidiba fan game
description:
Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer that brings Hoshimachi Suisei’s hit song "Bibbidiba" to life in an entirely new way. Players step into the shoes of Hoshimachi Suisei, navigating through magical worlds.

Nothing stands on your way!

As players traverse beautifully crafted levels, they must a combination of jump, punch, and of course, throwing shoes to avoid traps and defeat mischievous creatures in order to reach to the end goal.

Tick-tock! Tick-tock!

The clock is always ticking, adding an exciting time pressure element to the game. Players must complete each level before the clock runs out.

And More?

Players can take on optional boss or platform challenge to unlock additional bonuses. 

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)

This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".

Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed.

※1. About CCMC Corp.

CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

※2. About "holo Indie"

holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators.

It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.

For more details about "holo Indie", Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s "Derivative work guidelines".
